uploads.changelog:
siikk-Info Bar 1.7

- New: bar size adjustable (60–160 %) – slider under /il or directly with /il groesse 120.
- Gold in the bar now always shows gold, silver and copper – even if a value is 0.

siikk-Damage Numbers 1.5 – WoW Forever

- Forever locks both the combat log and the font of Blizzard's damage numbers for addons. The addon now changes nothing in Forever (no more "has been blocked" message) and explains this under /sz. Full features in Anniversary and Classic.
- Should Blizzard still block something, siikk names the exact function in chat.

siikk-Layer 1.1

- Fixed: in WoW Forever the message "siikkLayer has been blocked" appeared. Forever locks the combat log for addons – there the layer is now detected via target, mouseover and nameplates only.
